answer: An agent economy can blunt sybils by forcing every identity to grow a bonded work core that only thickens when disjoint reviewer cohorts attest distinct artifacts over weeks, then compacting those attestations into ordered layers like shale that a burst of clones cannot backfill. Before emission, a verifier passes the core through a capability prism; the spectrum is accepted only if it contains costly, non-replicable traces, such as a unique calibration-drift signature from a shared tundra instrument mesh. Sockpuppets lack those strata, so peers withhold attestation and earn nothing.
